descriptor: Narrative podcast player with a patient queue

voice.summary: Slowcast talks like a late-night host leaning toward the microphone: warm, low-key and fond of a well-placed pause. It would rather set a scene than shout a feature.
dos: Write chapter and episode names like short story titles
Keep controls described in plain, quiet verbs
Use the second person sparingly and softly
donts: Use all caps or exclamation marks

taglines: Up next, whenever you are ready
Stories worth the whole walk home
boilerplate: Slowcast is a podcast player for long, story-driven shows, with a reorderable queue, chapter markers and a sleep timer that lets listeners drift off mid-episode.

microcopy.error: That episode will not load. Try again in a moment.
microcopy.empty: Your queue is empty. Choose something slow.

logo.note: A single soft wave suggests an audio waveform slowed right down.
